title: Every user with Reports — Page Access sees the By technician tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the organization has closed at least one internal work order.
  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Reports — Page Access' and no other report-related permission, at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports > Internal Work Orders.
  2. Open the "By technician" tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report opens.

Step 2:

  • The By technician tab opens with its columns.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
